     - **Refund Issued:** 240.00 [m4]
     - **Cost Center Corrected:** CC-900-M11N [m2]

✅ Ticket updated in system with all details.

Dear Fabrikam Team,

We have processed your refund of **240.00** for the rebooking fee related to invoices incorrectly charged to the wrong cost center. The refund should reflect in your account within **3-5 business days** (timing varies by payment method).

**Corrected Cost Center:** Your registered cost center (**CC-900-M11N**) has been applied to the misbooked invoice(s), and all future transactions will use this cost center by default.

**Reference:** Ticket C-7873, Contract Record C-7873

Should you notice any further discrepancies or require assistance, reply to this email or reach out to our support at **support@fabrikam.com**.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
[Your Company] Operations Team
